scope: Bounded serial single-solid box/STEP tetrahedral meshing, MSH physical names, independently verified VTU conversion, FreeCAD and ParaView handoffs on 4.15.2. Named disjoint planar faces, independent triangle membership/area checks and remainder groups are qualified on the same runtime. Expanded supported primitive family: full axis-aligned cylinders, annular sleeves via a single-solid cut, and complete spheres; analytic CAD/node/surface checks; explicit planar cap area budgets and Delaunay/HXT plus optimisation readback. Named whole analytic cylindrical walls (typed OpenCASCADE cylinders on a world axis, inner/outer side) with independent host classification, material-side proof, unrolled area and chord deviation, plus a CAD surface inventory and adopted STEP inputs, are qualified on the same runtime. General CSG, other curved-wall families and surface/high-order meshing remain excluded.
acceptance: Run tools/qualify_gmsh.py with the target Gmsh Python and configured FreeCAD/ParaView; verify analytic meshes, STEP handoff, VTU readback, invalid sources and all kit integrity/lifecycle checks.

Run tools/qualify_gmsh_primitives.py with the target Gmsh Python, then source-current native conformance: primitive baseline/changed dimensions, circular STEP caps, strict/tight budget refusals, rehashed CAD/settings/boundary perturbation and lifecycle challenges.

Run tools/qualify_gmsh_cylinders.py with the target Gmsh Python, FreeCAD and meshio: literal sleeve, changed-radius/axis, FreeCAD two-bore plate with stale-selector recovery, deviation-driven refinement, adopted STEP with tamper/missing-capture cases, meshio consumption and refreshed-evidence adversaries.
